subject: Renewal: conditional rollover + onboarding refresh (Acme Corp)
messages:
From: Elliot James <elliot.james@acme-corp.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: conditional rollover + onboarding refresh (Acme Corp)

Hi Naomi —

Quick context: our current term with Redwood ends 2028-07-31. We ran the usage numbers and expect steady growth (approx +45% quarterly) if the pilot workloads expand. Procurement asked me to propose a path that avoids a hard cutover while giving us a committed price/capacity band.

Proposal we have on our side: a conditional rollover for an initial 3 months to bridge the renewal window, moving to a 12-month committed term once PO and attestation items are in place. We'd like to add +2 dedicated vGPU-equivalents starting month 2 of the new term.

Can you confirm Redwood's acceptance of a conditional rollover (month-to-month bridge with committed-month pricing applied retroactively upon PO receipt) and advise required docs for vendor onboarding refresh? Procurement needs an evidence bundle (SOC2 attestation + updated SLA) and a suggested PO template. I attached a simple commit matrix for our internal approvals (acme_requested_commit_matrix.xlsx).

Tl;dr asks:
- Can Redwood accept conditional rollover + retroactive commit application?
- What exact documents do we need to attach in the procurement portal to avoid delays?
- Estimated timeline once we submit the PO (SLA/attestation review + SOW redline turnaround)?

Thanks — appreciate a quick read so I can flag to procurement.

Elliot
Procurement Lead, Acme Corp
E: elliot.james@acme-corp.com
T: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: acme_requested_commit_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elliot James <elliot.james@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: conditional rollover + onboarding refresh (Acme Corp)

Hi Elliot — thanks for the clear ask and the matrix, that helps. Short answers up front: yes, we can support a conditional rollover bridge with retroactive application of committed pricing once a PO is received and onboarding items are completed; and yes, we can stage the +2 vGPU capacity ramp starting month 2.

Next steps from our side (I'll lead coordination):
1) I'll pull the renewal summary & SOW stub and share via Drive (attached redwood_renewal_summary.pdf).
2) Karthik (cc'd) will run a quick SOC2 & SLA verification so Procurement has the attestation bundle they need to upload to the portal.
3) Marissa will confirm pricing and any time-limited commercial concessions (discounts for commit).
4) We'll prepare a short mutual action plan for the procurement portal that maps required artifacts to expected turnaround (we aim for 3 business days for attestation review, 5 business days for SOW redline).

Please confirm the PO number format Procurement will use (we can accept the PO and apply commit retroactively once the PO is issued & uploaded). If procurement prefers, we can pre-fill the DocuSign SOW and keep it pending until PO is complete.

I'll follow up with the attestation checklist and a one-pager for the portal upload flow by EOD.

-Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Renewals & Customer Success, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_renewal_summary.pdf (summary stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: conditional rollover + onboarding refresh (Acme Corp)

Looping in commercial and contracts. A few pragmatic bullets:

- Pricing: recommend we offer a 10% commit discount on the requested 12-month band, with the conditional rollover billed at list month-to-month until PO is received. On receipt of PO (and portal evidence), apply discount retroactively to the bridge months.
- SOW turn: legal can do a light redline in ~3 business days; contracts needs the PO and the attestation bundle to start.
- Procurement portal preference: many of our enterprise customers prefer we supply a ZIP with the attestation, the signed SOC2 snapshot, and an SOW PDF for upload — that reduces back-and-forth.

Action items for this thread (short):
1) Naomi: share the attestation checklist + one-pager for procurement portal upload (you mentioned EOD).
2) Karthik: confirm SOC2 snapshot date + whether there are any environment changes that need callouts for the portal.
3) Rishi: please prepare the pricing quote with 10% commit discount and the commit bands (monthly token caps and the +2 vGPU uplift).
4) Laura: if procurement pushes for a master services amendment instead of a new SOW, can you confirm lead times?

I'll be on standby to approve the commercial concession if the timeline requires it. Keep responses inline so procurement has a single thread to reference.

Marissa
Director, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Thanks all — this looks good and actionable. Procurement has approved the conditional rollover concept provided the attestation bundle is uploaded to the portal and the PO is submitted within the 3-business-day review window.

We are attaching a scanned PO for the initial commit (ACME_PO_5489.pdf) — procurement will still upload artifacts to their portal but wanted to get the PO over to you so you can start applying the retroactive commit once we confirm upload. Please advise if you need anything else from our legal team.

I also uploaded a small redlines doc with callouts for the SOW; happy for your contracts team to do the normal light redline.

Elliot
Procurement Lead, Acme Corp

Attachments: ACME_PO_5489.pdf (PO stub)
